action_summary: Reverted the v17 regression by removing the six rm -rf commands that deleted fold_models/model_0..model_5, so the BiEncoderEvaluator again averages the full fold ensemble (v16 level, 0.38513) with the sigmoid blend kept. Added a Spearman-oriented post-processing step: each target column is rank-transformed to a uniform [0,1] scale (rank-invariant, guarantees the required range and handles NaNs), and for highly skewed targets (training dominant value at 0 or 1 with >=80% frequency) the lowest/highest-ranked half of that dominant fraction of test predictions is collapsed into a single tie, which reduces rank noise where the model has little signal. Predictions are clipped to [0,1] and written in the sample_submission format.
